texts: On day 425 of Year 2, Hesper proposed an experiment with three water sources.
Hesper filled the first cauldron with sea-water from the Salt-bloom Tide-pools.
Hesper filled the second cauldron with sea-water from the deep ebb.
Hesper filled the third cauldron with harbor water from the middle of the pier.
Hesper boiled silken threads in the three cauldrons for one day.
Mire-essence formed in the first cauldron.
The first cauldron yielded one vessel of mire-essence.
Mire-essence formed in the second cauldron.
The second cauldron yielded one vessel of mire-essence.
No mire-essence formed in the third cauldron.
The third cauldron yielded chalky residue.
Hesper reported the results to the Council.
The Council recorded the results in the ledger.

q1_issues.issue: The stated ordinals of "the first / second / third cauldron" are dropped entirely (no Ordinal atom anywhere), so the three cauldrons are told apart only by arbitrary witness indices, which carry no meaning for a question that names "the third cauldron".

"one vessel of mire-essence" is stored with the scale symbol `quantity`, which no word in the clause supplies, where the Measure rule reserves the slot symbol `unspecified` for a dimension no word states (same at statement 85).

q2_gaps: An enumerative ordinal on an entity ("the first/second/third cauldron") has no licensed filler for Ordinal's <scale> slot: there is no associated ordering event and no explicit "-est" dimension, and `unspecified` is licensed only in Measure-family slots.

An in-world calendar date "day 425 of Year 2" is a day-of-year count, not a day-of-month; the Time term inventory has no way to mark which, so (Day 425) is indistinguishable from an ordinary day-of-month reading.

"No" on a bare mass-noun subject ("No mire-essence formed in the third cauldron"): the instruction set makes a QuantifierPhrase companion mandatory for the explicit quantifier "no" yet also bars a companion whose range appears nowhere else in the parse, and the witness-based strength-0 denial it licenses for such a subject supplies no quantified range.
review.notes: Everything else holds up: cross-sentence coreference over 14 sentences, the negated-formation bundle with the indefinite subject kept inside, the compound genus atoms, the fill/boil/yield/record role choices, the duration measure and the entity-attached From of origin. (Location sk_record_1 sk_ledger_1) for "recorded the results in the ledger" is borderline against the "in a statement" example, but the ledger is a physical book, so the where-test supports it.

issues.reason: Real that the first / second / third labels go unencoded, so a question naming "the third cauldron" cannot bind, but overstated as a defect: Ordinal's <scale> slot admits only "the associated event, or an explicit '-est' dimension", and a purely enumerative index has neither (the same cauldron would take a different scale in each of fill / form / yield), so this is the reviewer's own gap 1 rather than a rule violation, and the omission asserts nothing false.

Measures & units states "A scale no word supplies is never invented — an unstated dimension takes the reserved slot symbol unspecified", and no word in "yielded one vessel of mire-essence" supplies quantity (that symbol is fixed to the Degree "too much / too little / enough" construction, not the Measure scale slot).

gaps_confirmed: enumerative ordinal on an entity ("the first / second / third cauldron") has no licensed filler for Ordinal's <scale> slot — no associated ordering event, no explicit "-est" dimension, and `unspecified` is licensed only in Measure-family slots
in-world day-of-year date ("day 425 of Year 2") is indistinguishable from an ordinary day-of-month under (Day <n>); the Time term inventory has no marker for which is meant

"No" on a bare mass-noun subject ("No mire-essence formed in the third cauldron") — the QuantifierPhrase companion is mandatory for an explicit "no" yet is also barred from naming a range that appears nowhere else in the parse, and the witness-based strength-0 denial that a mass subject licenses supplies no quantified range
new_gaps: container-measure phrase "N <container> of <mass>" ("one vessel of mire-essence") — the instruction set only EXCLUDES it from the genitive route ("a measure ('a cup of water')") and states no positive form; a licensed form would need to carry the container word as the unit, the count as the magnitude, and the substance as the bearer, without inventing a dimension word for the scale slot

a PLURAL kind word inside a multi-word proper name ("Salt-bloom Tide-pools") — the "Kestrel River" rule reads a singular type atom off the name's kind word, while the capitalized-plural-label rule ("the Wrens") bars any kind atom taken from a plural label word; the mixed case (multi-word name whose kind word is plural) is unsettled
adjudication.defect_summary: The compliant form for the confirmed issue is the reserved slot symbol in the scale position — (Measure sk_mire_essence_1 unspecified 1 vessel) and (Measure sk_mire_essence_2 unspecified 1 vessel), keeping the stated 1 and vessel — though the container-measure construction itself has no positively licensed encoding at all, which is filed as a new gap.
adjudication.notes: The rest of the 14-sentence parse is sound: cross-sentence coreference over all three cauldrons, the Instrument reading of "filled ... with sea-water", the entity-attached From of origin, silken_thread's material-adjective fusion with both decomposition atoms, record -> Theme per the evaluate/record carve-out, and the negated-formation bundle keeping its indefinite subject and Time/Location conjuncts inside. Reviewer statement pointers are 0-based and land correctly.
